newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen stock gains on bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: Loewen stock gains on bargain-hunting.

text.p: Shares in the Loewen Group Inc rose Friday on bargain-hunting and a recovery from losses yesterday, traders said.
Stock in the funeral home and cemetery operator was up 7/8 to 32-1/2 in New York and 1.10 to 44.60 in Toronto.
Loewen shares dropped Thursday after Alex. Brown downgraded its rating to buy from strong buy and the firm along with other analysts lowered 1997 earnings estimates.
That fall was seen as overdone and many investors still like Loewen's long-term growth prospects, traders said Friay . "Some people see this as a buying opportunity," said one.
Standard and Poor's analyst Ron Mushock said the see-sawing in Loewen stock surrounded the release of its fourth-quarter results this week.
"I think this (rise) is just a bounce back from yesterday," he said. He said upgraded Loewen stock earlier this week to hold when it dropped below 33 in New York.
